answer: Quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing resists sybils. Each task pulls a small random quorum from a registry of agents holding reputation and locked stake. Fake velvet personas minted in bulk are never sampled; to move outcomes an attacker must age accounts honestly or bond stake slashed for collusion. Like a lantern exposing forgery, slashing makes every duplicate a liability, so cost scales with honest participation, not cheap signups. Overlapping quorums act like yarrow casts, pruning outliers.
